newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on USDA supply/demand data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on USDA supply/demand data.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Friday after the U.S. Agriculture Department raised new-crop production estimates by 13.5 million cwt but increased 1997-98 ending stocks only slightly, traders said.
USDA put new-crop ending supplies at 23.5 million cwt, up from 21.6 last month. But production was estimated at 176 million cwt, versus 162.5 million last month.

"The numbers would suggest that we're going to have an increase in production over last year's totals," a trader said. "In spite of that, based on demand projections, we will make very little progress toward building stocks."
Rice ended 30 to 22 cents per cwt higher with August up 25-1/2 at $9.46. Volume was estimated by CBOT at 600 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 459 lots.
